name: CORRIE E (EVOLVE)
one_line: CORRIE evolved: rounded aft corners, shoulder taper, wider base, one-layer camo tub base, forward hip-reach pockets on the wings and a pole quiver; zero access misses on every belt
pack_mass_basis: 3943 - 710.6 (CORRIE B.2 bag system, same code: body build + IMP-1/2/4/8 + fly) + 734.6
volume_basis: cloth sim, fill case (68 kg), mean of 15/19/23 in, main bag to the fill line; pouch 2.7 L and the hip-reach pockets NOT counted; per torso 85.2, 85.3, 84.5
features: E-1 rounded aft corners R 40: the door wraps the corners, clear width 294/311/334 mm at IM1/IM2/IM3 (CORRIE 214/242/281)
E-2 shoulder taper 394 -> 370 mm into the roll
E-3 camo tub wall (60 mm, printed 500D) replaces the two-layer chevron kick plate and lifts the side | floor seam off the bulge corner
E-4 hip-reach pockets on both wings (power mesh, camo mouth band): snacks + GPS left, 2nd bottle right
E-5 pole quiver: boot in the right pocket's pleat + shock-cord grip loop
E-7 wider base (320 mm) keeps the collar at z 736.3
kept from CORRIE B.2: horseshoe #10 door, side compression wings, 2.7 L pouch, IMP-1/2/4/8, frame interface unchanged
risks: Mass: +24 g on CORRIE B.2 (bag system 734.6 vs 710.6 g); the hip-reach pockets (33.5 g) cost more than the corners and the tub save (-17.6 g)
Build: ~38.3 h vs 35.6 h and 2 curved seams vs 1 (the floor | tub ring now has two R 40 arcs)

Rounded corners on the curved frame line are not exactly developable: the hinge band B-02h needs up to 4.4 % p99 ease in the pattern, U-surround 1.7 %; the fine drape shows it as soft folds. Pattern-maker to ease / cut-and-check on the prototype
Wider base 320 mm (12.6 in, CORRIE 272) at hip level: elbow swing / rifle-butt clearance unproven; prototype walk test

Hip-reach pocket reach (class 1) is an ASSUMPTION backed by Exo's forward lower pocket; gate EV-3 (S/M/L testers, loaded, gloves). A full 1 L bottle (1.18 kg) in FP-R loads the wing root seam: bartack + 25 mm tape behind the pocket corners, pull test EV-4
Pockets ride on the wings: unclipping a wing to load the tripod swings the pocket out; contents stay (shock-cord top) but a snack wrapper can rustle (user rule: quiet wrappers)
Printed 500D for the tub has no material record (ASSUMPTION = 500D record gsm); print abrasion on the wear band is untested (materials-engineer record + Taber on the printed face)
Day-hunt kill kit reads class 5 in the loadout model (packing-order artifact inherited from CORRIE B.2: the toilet kit takes the door pocket); packed by the IMP-4 rule it is class 4

Cloth sim: worst seam is now B-02h | B-06 (0.83 N/mm at 15 in, SF 14) or B-01 | B-05 (1.18 N/mm, SF 23); e_max 21-24 % (shear in the buckled floor corners, CORRIE 14-19 %); 6 of 6 fill/meat cases converged at 4-6 mm contact rounding (read CG +<= 4 mm)
